title: MAFS bride Awhina Rutene breaks her silence over backlash surrounding husband Adrian Araouzou
text:
Married at first glance, the bride Awhina Rute has talked about the reaction surrounding her husband Adrian Araoouzou.
Speaking to Daily Mail Australia, the 30 -year -old care worker revealed that she felt “blind” for her explosive reaction to her past during the week of confessions.
The Reeh headquarters admitted that she was injured and confused after he seemed surprised by a revelation they had already discussed out of the camera.
Awhina explained that she and Adrian had talked openly about their past relationships at the beginning of the experiment.
‘He is really confused, to be honest. I felt really blind, “he said. “During our honeymoon, we had some conversations outside the camera where we talked about things and opened.”
However, when the theme was raised again in the camera, Adrian had a completely different reaction, one that Awhina did not see coming.

While Awhina acknowledged that what he had done in the past was ‘100 percent wrong’ and assumed all the responsibility, Adrian’s dramatic response confused her.

‘When I entered that room and he hadn’t made the letter, I thought it was a joke. I was smiling, laughing, thinking: ‘Come on, where is it?’ And when he said he hadn’t done it, I just thought: ‘Again? Actually?’ She remembered.

Despite the rocky road, Awhina and Adrian continued advancing, going to the commitment ceremony with the hope of finding common land.

As for their connection, Awhina revealed that while they struggled emotionally, physical intimacy was not a problem.
‘Intimacy was not something that was afraid to address. But no matter the challenge we face, we always manage to find highway potholes, ‘he shared.
“The spectators will only have to look and find out.”
In spite of everything, Awhina does not regret support Adrian throughout the experiment.
‘At the end of the day, when I am in a relationship with someone, I promote them. You should be the biggest cheerleader in your partner, “he said.
Meanwhile, rumors have been turned that Adrian was seen with someone new after the show, but Awhina took everything easy, even joking about Australia’s demand that he changes the color of his hair.
‘The public has been demanding that you dye your hair brown, who knows? I saw someone say it was me in a wig! Maybe I succumbed to the Australian group pressure, ‘he joked.
